MAIN_STACK.description: central housing, cover, and handle vertical stack

PCB_BRANCH.description: coherent protective plate, PCB, and support-frame branch

SENSOR_BRANCH.description: coherent tri-axis fixture and sensor-core branch
SENSOR_BRANCH.spacing_formula: anchor half-width plus sensor group half-width plus branch gap; local XYZ offsets from component bboxes

TOP_INTERFACE_BRANCH.spacing_formula: anchor half-width plus interface extent plus interface gap factors
